cleavage agent: A reverse-phase trapping column (0.3 mm inner diameter x 1 mm) containing 5 μm C18 300 Å Acclaim PepMap medium (Dionex) was loaded with the tryptic peptides at high flow rate.
enrichment method: Samples were enriched via a GFP-trap, and eluted material was subjected to SDS-PAGE and immunoblotting.
instrument: Liquid chromatography/tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) was carried out using an LTQ Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: The mass spectrometry proteomics data have been deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository with the dataset identifiers PXD031252 and 10.6019/PXD031252.
precursor tolerance: Mascot and X! Tandem were searched with a fragment ion mass tolerance of 0.020 Da and a parent ion tolerance of 10.0 PPM.
fragment tolerance: Mascot and X! Tandem were searched with a fragment ion mass tolerance of 0.020 Da and a parent ion tolerance of 10.0 PPM.
ptm: fixed Carbamidomethyl of cysteine; variable Glu->pyro-Glu of the N terminus; variable ammonia loss of the N terminus; variable gln->pyro-Glu of the N terminus; variable oxidation of methionine; variable phosphorylation of serine, threonine, and tyrosine

Carbamidomethyl of cysteine was specified as a fixed modification, Glu->pyro-Glu of the N terminus, ammonia loss of the N terminus, gln->pyro-Glu of the N terminus, oxidation of methionine and phosphorylation of serine, threonine, and tyrosine were specified in X! Tandem as variable modifications.
